subject: Career Technology
name: JHS 2 Career Technology
description: The JHS 2 Career Technology curriculum builds on the foundation of Basic 7, focusing on advanced health and safety practices, deeper exploration of materials, tools, and processes, and the application of technology in design and production. It also emphasizes entrepreneurial skills and career planning.

strands.title: HEALTH AND SAFETY
strands.description: Advanced practices in personal hygiene, food safety, and environmental health.

subStrands.title: PERSONAL HYGIENE AND FOOD HYGIENE
subStrands.description: Maintaing personal and food hygiene standards.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of basic practices that depict personal and food hygiene

indicators.description: Demonstrate skills of personal hygiene

exemplars.description: Think-pair-share on the causes of bad body odour. E.g., not bathing well.
Prepare personal hygiene cards/posters in groups to show causes of bad body odour.
Identify the appropriate materials used to prevent bad body odour. E.g., Lime/lemon, deodorant.
Demonstrate how to prevent bad body odour using the materials.
Plan and organise campaigns to educate the school community on the elimination of bad body odour.

indicators.description: Demonstrate skills in keeping food safe (food hygiene)

exemplars.description: Watch videos and pictures of the processes and skills of maintaining food hygiene and write down the observations. E.g., Store food appropriately, Keep hair clean, Wash hands regularly.
Role-play the skills of food hygiene in class for appraisal.

subStrands.title: PERSONAL, WORKSHOP AND FOOD LABORATORY SAFETY
subStrands.description: First aid and safety in work environments.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge of preventing accidents in the workshop/site/food/sewing laboratory

indicators.description: Demonstrate basic skills in applying First Aid to self and others

exemplars.description: Explain what is meant by First Aid. E.g., It is a help given to an injured/sick person till full medical treatment is available.
Identify and discuss the contents of a First Aid box. E.g., plaster, gauze, scissors, methylated spirit.
Demonstrate how to administer first aid to persons affected with cuts, burns, suffocation, scalds, and falls.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of the basic concept of Environmental health

indicators.description: Discuss the causal factors, effects and prevention of desertification and deforestation

exemplars.description: Identify the causal factors and discuss the effects and preventive measures of desertification and deforestation, in groups.
Group Project: Research the causal factors, effects and preventive measures of desertification and deforestation and develop a folder.
Present project findings in a report for appraisal.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of basic ways of disposing of household and industrial/workshop/site/laboratory waste

indicators.description: Identify proper management and disposal of household and industrial waste

exemplars.description: Discuss and report on the different ways of disposing off home and industrial waste (e.g., landfills, combustion) and proper disposal methods.
Undertake a project on how to recycle waste at home and in school.

strands.title: MATERIALS FOR PRODUCTION
strands.description: Understanding properties of compliant, resistant, smart materials and food commodities.

subStrands.title: COMPLIANT MATERIALS
subStrands.description: Properties of paper, card, and fabrics.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of the properties of compliant materials

indicators.description: Discuss the basic characteristics of compliant materials

exemplars.description: Identify the properties of paper (medium weight, smooth) and cardboard (stiff, smooth) that make them suitable for use.
Describe the properties of fabrics/textiles that make them suitable for use. E.g. Absorbent, Durable.

subStrands.title: RESISTANT MATERIALS
subStrands.description: Properties of resistant and building materials.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of properties of resistant materials

indicators.description: Explain the basic properties of resistant materials

exemplars.description: Discuss the physical properties of resistant materials (e.g., density, fusibility).
Investigate the working properties of resistant materials (e.g., strength, hardness, malleability).
Make a chart on the various properties of resistant materials.

indicators.description: Describe the properties of building materials

exemplars.description: Describe the properties of cement, sand, stones.
Discuss reasons for choosing a type of material for a building project.
Prepare a chart on properties of building materials.
Present chart for appraisal.

subStrands.title: SMART AND MODERN MATERIALS
subStrands.description: Applications of smart and modern materials.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding and the use of smart and modern materials

indicators.description: Discuss smart and modern materials

exemplars.description: Identify areas where smart and modern materials are in use.
Search for products made from smart and modern materials using ICT tools and other sources.

subStrands.title: FOOD COMMODITIES (ANIMAL AND PLANT SOURCES)
subStrands.description: Functions of food and meal planning.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of the functions of food commodities

indicators.description: Explore the functions of food to the body

exemplars.description: Classify food according to their basic functions. E.g., body-building, energy-giving, protective.
Relate food commodities to their functions.
Prepare a chart on the 3 functions of food commodities.

indicators.description: Discuss the basic food requirements for different members of the family

exemplars.description: Identify the different members of the family and their basic food requirements.
Review lesson on factors to consider when planning meals.
Plan a meal for a member of the family.
Display plan for appraisal.

strands.title: TOOLS, EQUIPMENT AND PROCESSES
strands.description: Using and maintaining tools for production.

subStrands.title: MEASURING AND MARKING OUT
subStrands.description: Tools and techniques for measuring and marking.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of measuring and marking out tools and equipment for production

indicators.description: Identify tools and equipment for measuring and marking out

exemplars.description: Describe the procedure for measuring and marking out artefacts/articles/products in various workshops.
Sketch and label parts of some measuring and marking out tools and equipment.
Present the sketched tools and equipment for appraisal in class.

indicators.description: Take measurements of products/artefacts/articles

exemplars.description: Discuss the importance and guidelines for taking body measurements in sewing.
Take each other's body measurements for garment construction.
Demonstrate how to handle the tape measure, mark out measured parts, record measurements, and indicate dimensions.
Demonstrate how to care for and maintain measuring and marking out tools.

indicators.description: Use appropriate techniques to measure

exemplars.description: Discuss portion control, equipment used and reasons.
Plan how to apply portion control in meal preparation.
Discuss the inaccuracies in using faulty measuring tools.
Measure ingredients for pancake and make it.
Measure objects/materials and make models/mock-ups.

indicators.description: Demonstrate how to care for and maintain measuring and marking out tools used for production

exemplars.description: Share experiences on caring for tools.
Identify cleaning agents for different materials.
Demonstrate cleaning of tools.

subStrands.title: CUTTING/SHAPING
subStrands.description: Tools and techniques for cutting and shaping.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of cutting/shaping tools and equipment used for making artefacts/ products

indicators.description: Discuss tools and equipment used for cutting and shaping

exemplars.description: Identify cutting and shaping tools in various trade areas.
Select appropriate cutting and shaping tools for making specific products.
Write the procedure involved in making the products.
Prepare a chart showing activities and tools.

indicators.description: Demonstrate how to use shaping and cutting tools and equipment for producing artefacts/products

exemplars.description: Demonstrate use of cutting and shaping tools for making products like wooden cabinets, sheet metal dust bins, bricks, dresses, and meals.
Write the procedure involved and exhibit products.

indicators.description: Demonstrate how to care for and maintain shaping and cutting tools and equipment

exemplars.description: Discuss care and maintenance of cutting/shaping tools in various trade workplaces.

subStrands.title: JOINING AND ASSEMBLING
subStrands.description: Tools and techniques for joining and assembling.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of joining and assembling materials, tools and equipment used for making artefacts/ products

indicators.description: Identify joining and assembling materials, tools and equipment used for making artefacts/products

exemplars.description: Identify materials, tools and equipment for joining from charts/realia in various trade areas.
Sketch and label some tools.

indicators.description: Use appropriate tools, equipment and techniques to join and assemble patterns/artefacts/products

exemplars.description: Demonstrate techniques in sewing and crocheting.
Demonstrate techniques for joining products made from wood, metal, bricks, plastics, and paper.

indicators.description: Demonstrate how to care for and maintain tools and equipment used for joining and assembling

exemplars.description: Demonstrate care and maintenance of joining tools in various workshops.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of maintaining kitchen essentials

indicators.description: Demonstrate how to care for and maintain kitchen essentials

exemplars.description: Discuss suitable cleaning materials for different kitchen essentials.
Demonstrate care and maintenance (washing, cleaning, sterilising) of basic kitchen essentials.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of application of finishes

indicators.description: Demonstrate how to mix the various finishes

exemplars.description: Identify tools used for mixing finishes.
Demonstrate procedure for mixing lacquer, emulsion paint, and oil paint.

indicators.description: Demonstrate skills of finishing edges of sewing articles and food products

exemplars.description: Discuss reasons for finishing edges of sewing articles.
Demonstrate edge finishing skills (binding, hemming, etc.).
Discuss and use garnishes for food products.

strands.title: TECHNOLOGY
strands.description: Understanding structures, forces, and simple mechanisms.

subStrands.title: SIMPLE STRUCTURES AND MECHANISMS, ELECTRIC AND ELECTRONIC SYSTEMS

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of application of principles of forces acting on structures

indicators.description: Perform experiments of principles of forces on structures

exemplars.description: Research types of forces (tension, compression, shear, torsion, bending).
Make sketches and notes of forces.
Identify materials for experiments.
Perform experiments to show how forces act on members.
Write observations.

indicators.description: Design and make simple school technology projects

exemplars.description: Identify simple school technology projects (e.g. see-saw, bridge).
Identify materials and tools.
Prepare a folio, plan, make mock-up, test, and evaluate.

strands.title: DESIGNING AND MAKING OF ARTEFACTS/PRODUCTS
strands.description: Drawing, designing, planning, and making artefacts.

subStrands.title: COMMUNICATING DESIGNS
subStrands.description: Drawing plane figures and pictorial views.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of drawing plane figures and solid objects using drawing instruments

indicators.description: Draw plane figures using instruments

exemplars.description: Identify 2-D figures.
Draw circles, triangles, quadrilaterals and polygons using instruments.
Prepare an album of cut-out shapes.

indicators.description: Draw objects in pictorial using instruments

exemplars.description: Explain pictorial drawing.
Identify methods of pictorial drawing (isometric, oblique, perspective).
Illustrate techniques and draw objects in isometric, oblique and perspective.

subStrands.title: DESIGNING
subStrands.description: Writing design briefs, researching, and generating ideas.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge and skills of Designing

indicators.description: Write a design brief

exemplars.description: Observe problem situations.
Write the problem situation.
State a suitable design brief.

indicators.description: Research into design problems

exemplars.description: Develop analysis chart.
State questions.
Conduct research.
Analyse data and write report.

indicators.description: Write Design Specifications

exemplars.description: Develop design specifications.
Give reasons for specifications.

indicators.description: Generate Ideas/possible solutions

exemplars.description: Sketch ideas.
Write notes on ideas.
Select best idea.
Develop selected idea and prepare working drawings.

indicators.description: Make artefact using resistant materials

exemplars.description: Study design folios.
Identify materials/tools.
Organise environment.
Make artefact.
Apply finish.

indicators.description: Test and evaluate made products/artefacts

exemplars.description: Test artefact.
State strengths/weaknesses.
Propose modifications.
Rate quality.

indicators.description: Demonstrate basic skills in cutting out designs without patterns in SEWING

exemplars.description: Explain free-hand cutting.
Apply free-hand cutting to cut out a simple blouse/shirt.
Cut out using paper for practice.

subStrands.title: PLANNING FOR MAKING ARTEFACTS/PRODUCTS
subStrands.description: Planning for production of artefacts and meals.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of planning for making artefacts/products and table setting

indicators.description: Plan and make wooden, metal/plastic artefacts

exemplars.description: Study design folio and working drawings.
Check workshop environment and safety.

indicators.description: Plan and make building artefacts

exemplars.description: Describe properties of building materials.
Make mock-ups.

indicators.description: Planning to make sewing artefacts/products

exemplars.description: Explain seams.
Identify and classify seams.
Discuss rules for making seams.

indicators.description: Planning to set a table

exemplars.description: Explain table setting.
Identify tools and equipment.
Discuss importance.
Discuss 'cover'.

subStrands.title: MAKING ARTEFACTS FROM COMPLIANT, RESISTANT MATERIALS AND FOOD INGREDIENTS
subStrands.description: Skills in table setting, sewing, and making resistant material artefacts.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of designing artefacts/ products, and models and table setting

indicators.description: Demonstrate Skills in table setting

exemplars.description: Set a table for one person.

indicators.description: Demonstrate skills in making sewing artefacts/products using seams and arrangement of fullness

exemplars.description: Make samples of seams.
Sew a blouse or shirt.
Identify and explain methods of arranging fullness (e.g. gathering, darts).
Make samples of arrangement of fullness.

indicators.description: Make artefacts/products using wood, metal/plastics

exemplars.description: Organise workshop.
Check dimensions.
Follow operation sequence to make artefact.
Prepare surfaces and apply finish.
Test and evaluate.

strands.title: ENTREPRENEURIAL SKILLS
strands.description: Career opportunities and small business management.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge of career opportunities in Career Technology

indicators.description: Explore the various career pathways and opportunities in Career Technology

exemplars.description: Research career pathways.
Write a report.
Examine interests and skills.
Compare options against skills.

subStrands.title: ESTABLISHING AND MANAGING A SMALL BUSINESS ENTERPRISE

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of establishing and managing micro and small business enterprises

indicators.description: Explain what is meant by Micro, Small and Medium-sized Business Enterprises

exemplars.description: Discuss meaning of Micro, Small and Medium enterprises.
Identify known businesses fitting the criteria.
Discuss steps in setting up.
List local businesses.
Classify businesses.
